> Vibecraft — web studio specialising in high-performance landing pages and Telegram Mini Apps for the HoReCa & food-tech industry.

## About

Vibecraft builds conversion-focused landing pages and custom Telegram Mini Apps that help restaurants, cafés, and food-service businesses attract clients and automate digital workflows.
